correctness.rationale: Syndrome conditions sum beta^j=sum beta^(3j)=0 are exactly the four BCH check-root conditions using Frobenius in GF(2^12). Reconstructed polynomial-field multiplication, checked alpha order 4095 and beta order 273, counted 36856 unordered exponent pairs, 210 complementary ordered matches with four distinct nonzero positions, 35 normalized weight-five sets containing zero, then seven full shift-orbits and 1911 supports; double-index Frobenius acts as a six-cycle and one fixed subgroup orbit. Counting normalization is exact since 5 and 273 are coprime. This exhaustive fixed-code enumeration is not an infinite BCH family proof.
